verdict.rationale: LobeHub's homepage says users can "Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest," and the usage docs include a dedicated "Scheduled Task" page under Agent. The dashboard also shows still-running work and a daily brief, which suggests recurring agent jobs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of recurrence options (cron or interval settings), details of the scheduling page itself, workflow-level scheduling beyond single agent tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
